description:
Olares recently sent their Olares One to try out.  The Olares One is a compact, high-performance personal AI cloud device. It is designed to run heavy AI workloads, local LLMs, and image/video generation pipelines locally without sending data to external cloud servers.  Oh, and it runs an open source Linux-based (Ubuntu-based) operating system!
